open_questions.question: Should the specialty courses cite exact-grade codes rather than band or standard-level anchors?
open_questions.detail: PE prints Grade 3/4 outcome codes (119 of them) and the arts GLCE prints Grade 3/4 expectation codes (186). Health and computer science are genuinely grade-banded (3-5 / Level 1B) and no exact-grade code exists to cite. This package records which is which; it does not choose.

open_questions.question: Are the health guidelines a standard at all?
open_questions.detail: The document is titled 'Standards Guidelines' and the approving press release describes guidance to districts under local control. Calling a citation against it 'a Michigan standard' is stronger than the source supports; this package says 'Michigan Health Education Standards Guidelines 2025, grade span 3-5' and nothing more.

open_questions.question: Does every authored Practice x Topic pairing exist in the 3-5 band?
open_questions.detail: The guidelines pair only some practices with some topics per grade span. The citations name practices and topics separately, so no pairing is asserted and nothing here contradicts the document - but a lane that later writes indicator codes must check the pairing exists.

open_questions.question: Is any of this educator-reviewed?
open_questions.detail: No. Nothing in this package is a licensed-educator review. Verified means the authored string was compared against the official document's bytes.

open_questions.question: Two health PDF filenames are in circulation.
open_questions.detail: The November 2025 press release links '---ADA-Final.pdf'; the Academic Standards index links '---ADA-final-with-edits-12-19-25.pdf'. This package holds the index one. The differences between them were not diffed.
